verdict.rationale: Vanta's first-party pages repeatedly say it automatically gathers evidence and continuously monitors connected systems, including integrations with AWS (40+ resources), identity providers, version control and similar tools, backed by automated tests. The API extends that automated collection to homegrown systems via Custom Tests. All of this is marketing-level vendor material, though: none of it documents a collection cadence, the format of the artifacts, or timestamping. missing for 10: documented collection schedule/frequency, evidence that artifacts are timestamped and replace screenshots/CSVs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
